_comment: Approved media for the site. ccVideo is the ~60-second Continuous Certification video. It renders (home page and /certified, top of the Continuous Certification block) ONLY when src is a same-origin file under /media/ and approvedBy and approvedOn are recorded. Captions are REQUIRED for all eight languages (en, cs, de, fr, es, it, pl, pt) as /media/*.vtt; without them the slot stays hidden. No third-party embeds (the site CSP and the privacy notice assume none).
